binary_sensor.docs:
The id of the [binary sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/) to add as an observation.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*

prob_given_false.docs:
**float between 0 and 1**: Assuming the event is false, the probability this observation is on.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*

prob_given_true.docs:
**float between 0 and 1**: Assuming the event is true, the probability this observation is on.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*

observations.docs:
A list of observations that influence the Bayesian probability of the event.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*

prior.docs:
**float between 0 and 1**: The prior probability of the event.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*

channels.key: Required for group or sum types
channels.docs:
A list of channels that are mapped to certain values.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*

channels.key: Required for group or sum types
channels.docs:
A list of channels that are mapped to certain values.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*

CONFIG_SCHEMA.docs: The sensor type. Should be one of: `BAYESIAN`, `GROUP`, or `SUM`.

binary_sensor.docs:
The id of the [binary sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor/) to add as a channel for this sensor.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*

value.docs:
The value this channel should report when its binary sensor is active.

*See also: [Binary Sensor Map](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/binary_sensor_map#configuration-variables)*
